notes: The text starts mid-sentence and contains only the Paramedic program description, its EMTP course sequence, a Career Options paragraph and a truncated COURSES tab. No requirements section, total or outcomes for the Emergency Medical Technology Certificate of Achievement appear, so no blocks were recorded. A reviewer should check the full page for the certificate section.
The listed EMTP 200, 200L, 202, 201, 201L, 203, 225, 230 and 231 courses belong to the Paramedic program, not this certificate, and were not recorded as blocks.

The Career Options paragraph names careers for earning a paramedic license. These are Paramedic on an ambulance, Critical Care Interfacility Transports, Flight Paramedic, Firefighter and Emergency Department Technician. They were not attributed to this EMT certificate. The reviewer should decide whether they apply.
The course descriptions show units that differ from the state file: EMT 101 shows 0.5 vs 1, and EMT 113 shows 7 vs 5. EMT 113L shows 2 units, where the state file stores none.
